snippet.title: Sea of Thieves Season 19 | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Sea of Thieves Season 19: Fights & Festivals is now open! 

⭕ Faction Battle Improvements
💀 New Allegiance Rewards
🐀 Act 2: Bilge Rats Weekender
⚓️ Act 3: Last Ship Standing
💯 100 Levels of Seasonal Rewards
🍺 And more to come: https://seaofthieves.com/season-19 

Get even more details with the full release notes: https://www.seaofthieves.com/release-notes/3.7.0

----------------------------------------

PLAY SEA OF THIEVES
Explore a vast open world in the ultimate pirate adventure game, available to buy on Xbox, PS5, Win 10/11 and Steam and Battle.net. Set sail and forge your own legend: https://www.seaofthieves.com/buy
